name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun Verma's journey into motorsport finance began with a lifelong fascination for racing and a keen eye for numbers. After completing his MBA with a focus on financial modeling, he sought to combine his passions. He started his career at a smaller racing outfit, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his rigorous approach to cost management and his uncanny ability to identify revenue opportunities where others saw only expenses. His reputation for fiscal prudence and innovative financial strategies soon caught the attention of Hitech GP. 

At Hitech GP, Arjun is responsible for overseeing the team's financial health, ensuring that every investment aligns with the team's long-term strategic goals. He believes in empowering team members with financial literacy, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the team's fiscal well-being. Arjun's visionary approach to motorsport finance involves leveraging data analytics to optimize spending and maximize returns, making him a highly valued asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial projections and racing trivia.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for quick calculations.
Starts every financial review meeting with a motorsport history fact.
